newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: TNT in talks with KLM on Euro-Asia links.
newsitem.headline: TNT in talks with KLM on Euro-Asia links.

text.p: TNT Express Worldwide is holding talks with several airlines including Dutch national carrier KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV, in a bid to improve its Asia-Europe express product, a TNT spokeswoman told Reuters on Thursday.
"We are in talks with a number of different airlines and aviation companies. It is very, very, early to talk of any final agreement on this," the spokeswoman said.
On January 7, TNT's Hong Kong general manager Bryan Chan said the group was negotiating with British Airways Plc to link its overnight express network in Asia with cities in Europe.

A KLM spokesman said: "TNT came to us to see whether we can play a role in their plans. They are planning to upgrade their express product by making stronger ties with Asia and Europe. KLM has very good links from Europe to Asia."
Talks have been going on for the last couple of weeks and they will continue, he added.
TNT is expected to be wholly-owned by Dutch post office and telecoms group Koninklijke PTT Nederland NV by the end of this month following a successful takeover bid in later 1996.
